details: The legacy createBrowserChatDriver started a 5-second setInterval that SSH/CDP-scanned ChatGPT page DOM. The Chrome M144 remote-debugging Allow prompt is Chrome-owned UI outside page-level CDP, so the watcher could never click it; repeated scans added CPU/SSH work. Fix requires no interval, default off and honest page-level boundary.
